text: Duration: 4 weeks, July 1 to July 26 Beginning Time: July 1 for registration; Suitable Applicants: Foreigners who have basic oral Chinese skills, but could not express his/her ideas fluently. Curriculum: Morning: Oral Chinese and communicative ability, based of topics, language functions and language elements concerning everyday life, study and social activities. Afternoon: Field practice related to topics learned in the morning Self-paid trips: Self-paid trips to Quanzhou, Zhangzhou, Longyan, Wuyi Mountain can be arranged if there more than 15 students willing to go. Certificates: Certificates for Completion of Study indicating the study periods. Application Deadline: June 15, please contact us for further solution in case you apply beyond the date. Visa: Please apply X or F visa from the local Chinese Embassy in your country with the admission notice and visa application form (jw202) issued by OEC. If you apply too late or receive no admission notice and jw202 form from us, please contact OEC for permission, and then apply for tourist visa (>30 days). Tuition fees: 3200RMB, including: textbooks and tuition. Textbooks are given for free to those who join the program from the beginning.
